score_method: Codex review of all 40 complete main-suite transcripts, internal state, catalogue evidence and configured store facts. One holistic outcome score per scenario, using the calibration and dimensions in eval_harness/judge.py RUBRIC. This is not output from judge.py and no additional paid judge was called. The overall score is the equal-weight mean of these 40 scores; offline test counts and incomplete historical replays do not enter the score.
